title: [dynamic shapes] Preserve algebraic relationships in foreign unbacked SymInt transfer (#188723)
body:
Fixes #188723

`ShapeEnv._transfer_foreign_expr_as_unbacked` had an order-dependent bug: when a composite foreign expression (e.g. `u0 + u1`) was transferred before its base unbacked symbols (`u0`, `u1`) had been seen individually, the algorithm collapsed the composite to a single opaque local symbol, losing algebraic relationships such as `new_sizes[0] == new_sizes[1] + new_sizes[2]`.

Fix: insert a leaf-symbol pre-seeding step between the cache-only substitution and the opaque-fallback mint. For every unresolved foreign free symbol that is a base unbacked symint, mint a fresh local unbacked symbol one-to-one (deterministic ordering, `EphemeralSource`), then re-run substitution. Also correctly propagate `is_size`/`size_like` range constraints to all base symbols seeded from a composite size expression (including when the composite appears before its leaves).

Tests updated/added in `test/test_dynamic_shapes.py`.
